column1: # note: regenerated with the current binaries and pipeline-driver defaults

# note: pairs scored: 290 Compara paralogue pairs on chr16 whose two genes both have a locus (representative >= 200 bp) in Rustle's chr16 assembly (spectrum truth_pairs, score.py spectrum --skip-t3; conditioned on the assembler's loci, not on read counts)

# note: families = the DEFAULT de novo families: the driver's families stage (mcl_families --from-gtf --min-exonic-bp 1 --min-shared-exon-frac 0.60 --emit-units, MCL 2.8) on the chr16 restriction of the genome-wide A119b assembly (loci seeded with secondary alignments within 2% of the read's best score); one copy per member locus = its representative transcript; copies mapped to genes by span (score.py pairs): 353 copies, 88 families, largest 22 genes; single-exon copies 95/353

# note: view edge_asm20 = minimap2 asm20, identity >= 0.80, coverage >= 0.50 (query span / shorter length); edge_nt = asm20 or asm20 -k11 -w5 (identity >= 0.60, coverage >= 0.50); a DIRECT nucleotide alignment between any loci of the two genes (one representative per locus); the translated protein tier is in the supplement (fig6s_protein_tiers)

# note: view families = both genes in one default family (score.py pairs --universe); families_edge / families_no_edge split it by the direct alignment of the same pair (edge_nt): with one, or joined without one (through other loci of the family); families_both_members = both genes have >= 1 copy in some family (the most the families can recover)

# note: hits = round(sensitivity x n) from spectrum.tsv (exact: the scorer writes hits/n); column recall = sensitivity; ci = Wilson 95%, which treats pairs as independent (they are not: see fig6_chr16_groups)
